findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂も間桐も目的である聖杯を手に入れていない
findings.governingReading: The English coordinates the two families as the subject of a negative correlative.
findings.explanation: Neither is paired with or rather than nor.

findings.highlight: She's never been here as a guest.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は客として来訪したのではない
findings.governingReading: 客として来訪したのではない defines her present status on entering uninvited.
findings.explanation: Not coming as a guest on this visit becomes never having been here as a guest.

findings.highlight: to eliminate her enemies in the Holy Grail War.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争を汚す外敵を排除しに
findings.governingReading: 聖杯戦争を汚す外敵 explains her stated purpose as removal of an external contaminating force.
findings.explanation: An outside enemy corrupting the Grail War becomes merely her enemies in it.

findings.highlight: the guilt she's been bearing towards a certain someone for the last ten years.
findings.evidenceJa: 十年以上も我慢し続けた、誰かに対する後悔だった
findings.governingReading: 十年以上も我慢し続けた modifies 誰か, the person toward whom Rin feels regret, following her wish to have come sooner.
findings.explanation: Regret toward someone who has endured for over ten years becomes Rin bearing guilt for ten years.

findings.highlight: walks down the wet stone steps.
findings.governingReading: 石畳 names the paving she reaches underground, not a staircase surface.
findings.explanation: Descending onto damp stone paving becomes walking down wet stone steps.

findings.governingReading: 後継ぎを鞭打ち explicitly names physical whipping in the inverted human-and-insect rearing sequence.
findings.explanation: Whipping the heir becomes disciplining successors.

findings.highlight: the Magic Crest engraved in her arm.
findings.evidenceJa: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み
findings.governingReading: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み is one of Rin’s specific remembered hardships.
findings.explanation: The pain of an engraved Magic Crest becomes simply the Crest engraved in her arm.

findings.highlight: personally inducted into the Mage's Association as a prodigy.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術協会が特待生として迎え入れようとするほど
findings.governingReading: 特待生として迎え入れようとするほど describes prospective recruitment as a specially admitted student.
findings.explanation: Being exceptional enough that the Association wants to welcome her becomes personal induction.

findings.highlight: She could only eat her words
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は言葉を飲むしかない
findings.governingReading: 言葉を飲むしかない means falling silent when asked whether she could endure being the insects’ plaything.
findings.explanation: Swallowing her answer becomes eating her words.

findings.highlight: the fierce air she's giving off.
findings.governingReading: 純粋に、遠坂凛という少女が放つ殺意 distinguishes fear of her actual intent to kill from fear of her Servant-backed Master status.
findings.explanation: Rin’s personally emanating murderous intent becomes a fierce air.

findings.highlight: I have no idea what the geezer's been up to this whole time!
findings.evidenceJa: 僕は今まで知らなかったんだ
findings.governingReading: 今まで知らなかった bounds Shinji’s claimed past ignorance, not necessarily his present knowledge.
findings.explanation: Not knowing until now becomes still having no idea.

findings.highlight: if he says one wrong word.
findings.governingReading: 下手に言い淀めば makes stalled disclosure the risk in Rin’s dangerous mood.
findings.explanation: Hesitating over words becomes saying a wrong word.

findings.highlight: if he tells her how he became a Master.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターになった理由を明かす事
findings.governingReading: マスターになった理由 is the motive that feels like death to reveal; the interrupted thought resumes after Rin supplies his status-seeking motive.
findings.explanation: Disclosing why he became a Master becomes explaining how he did it.

findings.highlight: he won't let himself lose to anyone.
findings.evidenceJa: それだけは他の誰にも負けない、彼が一番たり得るところよ
findings.governingReading: それだけは他の誰にも負けない identifies the one quality where he is unsurpassed; Rin subsequently defines it as other-directed striving and self-hatred.
findings.explanation: The indispensable disposition in which Shirou is unsurpassed becomes refusing to let himself lose.

findings.highlight: can't even see the departing Rin anymore.
findings.evidenceJa: 去っていく遠坂凛を見つめる事しかできない
findings.governingReading: 去っていく遠坂凛を見つめる事しかできない describes his immobilized watching, with the next sentence explaining why he cannot attack.
findings.explanation: Only being able to watch her leave becomes being unable even to see her.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分が好きなあまり周りを下に見たものの
findings.governingReading: Rin says excessive love of himself led Shinji to look down on others, whose superiority then trapped him in inferiority. This follows her description of a disposition involving self-hatred.
findings.explanation: Rin's explanation loses the excessive self-love that she says produces Shinji's contempt. The contrast with her preceding description of self-hatred is consequently less explicit.

findings.highlight: You're the only one who thinks you're stuck
findings.evidenceJa: 詰まっているように思えるのは本人だけ
findings.governingReading: 詰まっている contrasts supposed inner substance with the preceding empty interior and following inflated balloon.
findings.explanation: Believing he is full inside becomes believing he is stuck.
